_note: Settings for npm run civic. 'feeds' are iCalendar (.ics) URLs to fetch; .ics files saved in data/civic/ are read too. 'usual' is the regular council schedule from the city's Televised Meetings page ('First and third Tuesday at 5:30 pm'); it fills in when no feed lists a council meeting that day. Put dates the city moves or cancels in 'skip' (YYYY-MM-DD) and one-off meetings in 'extra'.
venue: Katie Dorsett Council Chamber, Melvin Municipal Office Building
